H1.name_ja: 単身・パート（130万円の壁付近）
H1.name_en: Single part-time employee near the 1.3m wall
assumptions: Lives alone, so cannot be a health-insurance dependant; the 1.06m/1.3m dependant walls do not apply as modelled (OPEN_QUESTIONS Q21).
National-pension low-income exemptions are not modelled, so take-home at very low pay is understated (OPEN_QUESTIONS Q20).
Works 20+ hours a week for an employer with 51+ staff, so employee insurance applies once monthly pay reaches 88,000 yen.
Salary is paid in 12 equal months with no bonus (approximation: true).
Lives in Shinjuku ward, Tokyo (HUMAN_TODO H-8).

H2.name_en: University student with a part-time job, parents' dependant
assumptions: Modelled as the student alone; the parents are outside the household, so their dependant deductions are not counted (OPEN_QUESTIONS Q16).
Covered by a parent's employee health insurance as a dependant while income stays under the limit.
Uses the national-pension student payment deferral (学生納付特例), so pays no contribution in 2026.
Salary is paid in 12 equal months with no bonus (approximation: true).
Lives in Shinjuku ward, Tokyo (HUMAN_TODO H-8).

H3.name_en: Dual-income employee couple, two children (2 and 8)
assumptions: Both are full-time employees in 協会けんぽ (Tokyo).
Salary is paid in 12 equal months with no bonus (approximation: true).
Lives in Shinjuku ward, Tokyo (HUMAN_TODO H-8).
Spouse works under 20 hours a week, so is not in employee insurance and is a health-insurance dependant and category-3 pension member while income stays under 1.3m.
Salary is paid in 12 equal months with no bonus (approximation: true).
Lives in Shinjuku ward, Tokyo (HUMAN_TODO H-8).
The parent is a mother (matters only for a 40,000-yen difference in the resident-tax 調整控除 base).
児童扶養手当 (child-rearing allowance for single parents) is outside the v1 baseline (spec Section 3); OPEN_QUESTIONS Q17.
Salary is paid in 12 equal months with no bonus (approximation: true).
Lives in Shinjuku ward, Tokyo (HUMAN_TODO H-8).
Both in Shinjuku National Health Insurance.
Long-term-care premiums for people 65+ (介護保険 第1号) are not yet modelled (OPEN_QUESTIONS Q15).
Lives in Shinjuku ward, Tokyo (HUMAN_TODO H-8).
In Shinjuku National Health Insurance and pays the national pension.
Lives in Shinjuku ward, Tokyo (HUMAN_TODO H-8).

H8.name_ja: 高所得共働き・子1人（5歳）
assumptions: Both are full-time employees in 協会けんぽ (Tokyo).
Salary is paid in 12 equal months with no bonus (approximation: true).
Lives in Shinjuku ward, Tokyo (HUMAN_TODO H-8).
